source: Native screenshot of the installed plugin Settings page, captured through the app UI.
crop: Preview, built-in and user preset rows, and appearance controls only. Settings navigation, window title and the open-project table are excluded.
demoData: Frontend, Backend, Tools, example editor text, branch names and line counts are built-in preview fixtures. The user-preset row shows a generic Git-with-icons style name.
processing: Rectangular crop and lossless PNG encoding; UI pixels and labels were not redrawn or retouched.
settings: Built-in and user presets were selected only in pending Settings drafts and discarded with Cancel. Saved appearance, Custom memory, named presets and theme were preserved after the 0.3.56 capture.
